page_title: WOL 1-3 MON | Wolfsburg v B. Monchengladbach 07/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' Wolfsburg have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

90+6' Kevin Behrens (Wolfsburg) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Wolfsburg.
90+5' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
90+4' Moritz Jenz (Wolfsburg) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar.
90+3' Jonas Omlin (B. Monchengladbach) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
90+2' Vaclav Cerny (Wolfsburg) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' Mattias Svanberg will be replaced by Aster Vranckx (Wolfsburg).
88' 1 - 3 Goal! Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) fires the rebound into the top right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:3.
88' Gerardo Seoane decides to make a substitution. Franck Honorat will be replaced by Jordan Siebatcheu (B. Monchengladbach).
88' The manager makes a subsitution with Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) coming on for Luca Netz.
86' The resulting set piece from Wolfsburg is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
84' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
83' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) receives a lofted pass from the flank and shoots from close range, but the ball flies slightly wide, almost brushing the left-hand post.
82' Here is a change. Alassane Plea is going off and Gerardo Seoane gives the last tactical orders to Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach).
81' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 8:9.
78' B. Monchengladbach string together a series of short passes.
76' Moritz Jenz (Wolfsburg) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Bastian Dankert blows his whistle for a foul.
74' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) connects with a cross near the penalty spot and produces a header which hits the crossbar!
73' That will be all from Jonas Wind who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Kevin Behrens (Wolfsburg).
73' Ralph Hasenhuttl prepares a substitution. Ridle Baku is replaced by Vaclav Cerny (Wolfsburg).
72' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 58:42.
70' Gerardo Seoane has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) replacing Nathan Ngoumou.
70' Substitution. Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) in, Ko Itakura out.
70' Maximilian Wober (B. Monchengladbach) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
68' Maximilian Wober (B. Monchengladbach) picks up an injury.
66' Jonas Omlin leaps to intercept the corner kick from Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg).
66' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The ball goes behind for a corner. Wolfsburg will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
64' A precise low pass is received by Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
63' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

58' 1 - 2 Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) latches on to a precise pass deep inside the box from Franck Honorat, and he beats the goalkeeper with a low accurate shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:2.
57' Ralph Hasenhuttl has decided to substitute Patrick Wimmer and he is replaced by Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg).
57' The referee signals a substitution. Amin Sarr (Wolfsburg) is brought on as a substitute for Tiago Tomas.
57' The cross into the penalty area from Stefan Lainer (B. Monchengladbach) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
54' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) was too forceful with his tackle and Bastian Dankert interrupted the game to signal a free kick.

52' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) tries his luck from the edge of the box and his shot takes a deflection and goes past the stranded Pavao Pervan. He makes it 1:1.
52' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
50' Wolfsburg keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
48' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) unleashes a beautiful mid-range volley to the middle of the goal, but his effort is thwarted by the keeper, and the score remains the same.
46' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) was quite harsh and Bastian Dankert didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) has a great chance to score from deep inside the box! He finds some space for the shot, but sends it errantly way past the left post. Very poor attempt.
43' A player from Wolfsburg brings down an opponent and commits a foul.
41' 0:4 – the corner kicks stats.
39' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for B. Monchengladbach.
39' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Jonas Omlin, who smothers the ball.
36' Maximilian Wober (B. Monchengladbach) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.

34' The referee blows his whistle after Maximilian Wober (B. Monchengladbach) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball. It's a free kick to Wolfsburg, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
31' A player from Wolfsburg commits a rough challenge. Bastian Dankert blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
30' The total number of attempts is 2:3.
28' One of the players from B. Monchengladbach times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
27' Sebastiaan Bornauw (Wolfsburg) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Bastian Dankert had an easy-decision to make.
26' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
25' B. Monchengladbach take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

25' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The linesman points to the corner flag, B. Monchengladbach are going to take it.
23' Wolfsburg hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.

21' Maximilian Wober (B. Monchengladbach) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the left post.
20' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
19' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
18' The ratio of the ball possession is 65:35.

16' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
15' Wolfsburg keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
13' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
12' Bastian Dankert interrupts the game. One of the players from B. Monchengladbach won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
10' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.

7' 1 - 0 Goal! A terrific long pass from Tiago Tomas picks out an unmarked Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) inside the box. He has time and space to pick his spot and slams the ball into the right side of the goal. 1:0.
5' A pass by Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.

3' Great solo effort by Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) as he tricks his way through two defenders before firing a drive from just outside of the box towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper is ready and produces a stunning save.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and B. Monchengladbach will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Bastian Dankert.
